item.title: Manteca revenues up $4.2M & expenditures $3.1M at mid-year point
item.description: Manteca has collected more revenue than expected in the overall budget to the tune of $4.2 million as of the mid-point of the fiscal year.

item.title: Vikings charge past Spartans in 4th quarter
item.description: Midway through the fourth quarter Wednesday, the score was tied for the eighth time between Lathrop and Johansen before the visiting Vikings scored 15 of the game’s final 19 points to escape Greg Leland Gymnasium with a 58-47 Western Athletic Conference boys basketball win.

item.title: Buffs, Lancers battle to scoreless draw
item.description: Less than a month ago, the Manteca Buffaloes went to Dino Cunial Stadium and picked up a massive 3-0 Valley Oak League win over rival East Union. Safe to say the Lancers remembered the loss well, as they visited Manteca’s Guss Schmiedt Field on Wednesday night and put on a gritty performance in a 0-0 draw between two teams fighting for playoff seeding in their respective divisions.

item.title: Abrew aims high
item.description: Another East Union receiver is on his way to an NCAA Division I school. J.P. Abrew locked in his commitment to Air Force on Wednesday during a signing ceremony at East Union’s new small gym two months after teammate Jackson Fay inked with UC Davis.

item.title: The $200M EV rebate question: Color Gov. Newsom’s California a pale shade of green
item.description: California is not serious about reducing greenhouse gas emissions. If they were, those bemoaning the loss of the federal EV rebate of $7,500 that happened at the end of September would not be pushing for California to revive its own EV rebate with what critics have complained is a “paltry” $200 million that Gov. Gavin Newsom set aside for such an endeavor.

item.title: A bit of fresh air for the 2026 State of the City
item.description: The 2026 State of the City is taking place in the afternoon and outdoors in downtown Manteca.

item.title: MANTECA UPS ITS GAME IN NEIGHBORHOOD PARKS
item.description: Manteca is not waiting on a new community park or getting implementation of the updated master plan rolling to step up its park facility game.

item.title: Teen on off-road dirt bike pinned under semi-truck
item.description: A 17 year-old sustained serious injuries Tuesday when he collided with a semi-truck in the intersection of Main Street and Yosemite Avenue.

item.title: 206,882 residents in Manteca by 2040? It’s not exactly city’s plan
item.description: It was an unnerving number for Councilman Charlie Halford — 206,882 residents in Manteca by 2040.

item.title: MISS MANTECA ADVOCATING FOR THE RITECARE LANGUAGE CENTER
item.description: Kylie Anderson on Friday will enjoy the sound of a friendly rivalry as students from Manteca and Sierra high schools fill the Manteca High gym to cheer on their respective boys’ basketball teams in a Valley Oak League showdown.
